# Support

- Use these routes when you need help with this project.
  - Getting help
    - Read the README first, because it covers installation and normal use.
    - Search the open and closed issues, since someone may have hit the same thing.
    - Open an issue when neither of those answers your question.
  - When you open an issue
    - Say which Alibre Design version you are running.
    - Say what you did, what you expected, and what happened instead.
    - Attach the script or part file that shows the problem, when you can share it.
  - What this project does not cover
    - Take questions about Alibre Design itself to Alibre at <https://www.alibre.com/>.
    - Report a security problem through SECURITY.md rather than a public issue.
